g.text: A low value hands the movement to the trend and leaves a flat cycle; a high
one holds the trend straight and pushes every swing into the cycle.
Central Bank of the Congo, World Bank, IMF; author’s calculations.
λ = 1600, the quarterly convention applied as it stands
λ = 14400, the monthly value used throughout this page
